# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.x     | Yes       |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Email [security@geekybones.com](mailto:security@geekybones.com) with:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof-of-concept
- Any suggested fix, if you have one

You will receive an acknowledgement within 48 hours. We aim to release a patch within 14 days of confirming the issue, depending on severity and complexity. We will credit you in the release notes unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

## Scope

This policy covers the `geekybones/fraud-defense-bundle` package. Vulnerabilities in upstream dependencies (e.g. `google/cloud-recaptcha-enterprise`, Symfony components) should be reported to their respective maintainers.
